summary: E-Home Household Service Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting that on May 5, 2026, the Nasdaq Hearings Panel granted its request for continued listing on The Nasdaq Capital Market. The company was previously notified of non-compliance with the minimum bid price rule. The Panel imposed heightened listing criteria, requiring demonstrated compliance with the Bid Price Rule until September 14, 2026, prohibited a reverse stock split during this period, and added a one-year Panel Monitor. The registrant intends to maintain strict compliance. This is a routine regulatory update regarding listing compliance, not a special situation.
